summary: Kerb lined with parked cars; homes 16-19 m behind and a college across.
reasons: Homes 16-19 m away on this side
Daytime no-parking only; stopping ban near the end

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 16-19 m back behind front gardens and trees; a student dormitory about 19 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide road with cars parked tight along the kerb on both sides; a van fits in the line.
drivers.traffic: Through road by the university; busier by day.
drivers.convention: Parked cars line the kerb; signs ban parking Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, so nights are open, but a No Stopping Any Time sign sits near the far end.
